channel.title: AI GridWatch — Iowa data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Iowa, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Jefferson County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Moratorium on data centers passed by supervisors

item.title: Dubuque County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month pause on permits and zoning requests for data center construction or expansion, amended up from 120 days; county will host weekly work sessions and at least four public town halls

item.title: Marshalltown: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: 4-month moratorium passed first reading 6-1; motion to waive subsequent readings failed. Council previously voted down a 6-month moratorium in Jun

item.title: Johnson County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium in unincorporated areas, unanimous. Excludes Iowa City, North Liberty, Coralville. Water/electrical bill concerns

item.title: Linn County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 18-month moratorium on EU-3 Large-Scale Data Center rezoning in unincorporated areas, 2-1. Can end early or extend

item.title: Dubuque County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium, 2-1. Originally proposed as 120 days, extended during meeting. Planning and Zoning Commission had unanimously recommended the pause

item.title: Woodbury County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium in unincorporated areas, 5-0. Does NOT affect Salix, which annexed ~900 acres that MidAmerican Energy confirmed is being considered for a data center

item.title: Plymouth County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium on data centers and industrial battery storage, 4-0 (one absent). Revocable or extendable at any time

item.title: Sioux County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium on data centers and battery storage in unincorporated areas. PathOne Data Centers considering redeveloping former Bison Renewable Energy property near Hull

item.title: Ida County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Indefinite moratorium, unanimous. Supervisors want more information before allowing development

item.title: Madison County: data center moratorium — Enacted
Shelby County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Moratorium through Jul 2027 while permanent rules are developed

item.title: Clarke County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Temporary moratorium while permanent rules are developed

item.title: Clinton: data center moratorium — Rejected
item.description: Proposed moratorium rejected 5-2 as QTS considers an AI data center campus north of US-30/west of Mill Creek Parkway; council members argued a pause could send the wrong message to developers.

item.title: Salix: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: 1-year moratorium on data centers, formal vote scheduled Aug 12, 2026. Council voted 3-2 (Jul 8) to advance the concept after 100+ residents debated a MidAmerican Energy data center on ~900 acres of annexed farmland.

item.title: Linn County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 18-month pause on large-scale data center rezonings in unincorporated areas, passed 2-1 and effective immediately — adopted even after the county had put an ordinance in place
